title: Canonical local pure tensor in the cochain module-sheaf tensor
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site essentially small relative to the coefficient universe, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and use its module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For module sheaves $M,N$, an object $U$ of $\mathcal C$, and local sections $x\in M(U)$ and $y\in N(U)$, define $\operatorname{moduleTmul}(M,N,U,x,y)\in(M\otimes_R N)(U)$ as follows: take $x\otimes_{R(U)}y$ in the sectionwise presheaf tensor, apply the unit of module-presheaf sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and then apply the inverse of the canonical identification $M\otimes_R N\cong(M\otimes_{p,R}N)^\#$. This definition introduces only the canonical pure-tensor section, with no choice of tensor comparison and no claim that all tensor sections are globally pure.
